results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM("l"."price_lcl" * "fx"."rate"), 2) AS "net_revenue_usd" FROM (SELECT "ord_id", "cust_id", "ord_stat_cd", "purch_ts", "appr_ts", "carrier_ts", "dlvr_ts", "est_dlvr_dt", "is_deleted", "src_sys_cd" FROM "sales"."ord_hdr" WHERE (is_deleted = FALSE)) AS "h" JOIN (SELECT "ord_id", "line_no", "prod_id", "seller_id", "ship_lmt_ts", "price_lcl", "frt_lcl", "ccy_cd" FROM "sales"."ord_line") AS "l" ON "l"."ord_id" = "h"."ord_id" JOIN (SELECT "rate_dt", "from_ccy", "to_ccy", "rate", "is_filled" FROM "finance"."fx_rate_daily") AS "fx" ON "fx"."rate_dt" = CAST("h"."purch_ts" AS DATE) WHERE NOT "h"."ord_stat_cd" IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND "h"."purch_ts" >= CAST('2017-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND "h"."purch_ts" < CAST('2018-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 1000
assumptions: Amounts converted from BRL to USD at the daily rate of the order date.

results.sql: WITH "net_revenue" AS (SELECT SUM("l"."price_lcl" * "fx"."rate") AS "net_revenue_lcl" FROM (SELECT "ord_id", "cust_id", "ord_stat_cd", "purch_ts", "appr_ts", "carrier_ts", "dlvr_ts", "est_dlvr_dt", "is_deleted", "src_sys_cd" FROM "sales"."ord_hdr" WHERE (is_deleted = FALSE) AND (cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM crm."CUST_MSTR_V2" WHERE is_current AND cust_state IN (SELECT state_cd FROM ref.region WHERE region_cd IN ('SE'))))) AS "h" JOIN (SELECT "ord_id", "line_no", "prod_id", "seller_id", "ship_lmt_ts", "price_lcl", "frt_lcl", "ccy_cd" FROM "sales"."ord_line" WHERE (ord_id IN (SELECT h.ord_id FROM sales.ord_hdr AS h JOIN crm."CUST_MSTR_V2" AS c ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id AND c.is_current WHERE c.cust_state IN (SELECT state_cd FROM ref.region WHERE region_cd IN ('SE'))))) AS "l" ON "l"."ord_id" = "h"."ord_id" JOIN (SELECT "rate_dt", "from_ccy", "to_ccy", "rate", "is_filled" FROM "finance"."fx_rate_daily") AS "fx" ON "fx"."rate_dt" = CAST("h"."purch_ts" AS DATE) WHERE NOT "h"."ord_stat_cd" IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND "h"."purch_ts" >= CAST('2017-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND "h"."purch_ts" < CAST('2018-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP)) SELECT ROUND("net_revenue"."net_revenue_lcl", 2) AS "net_revenue_usd" FROM "net_revenue" AS "net_revenue" LIMIT 1000
assumptions: Amounts converted from BRL to USD at the daily rate of the order date.
